# SpringConstraint2D

- Inherits [`Constraint2D`](constraint2d.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpringConstraint2D")`

A distance between two points, held softly: a spring, a bungee, a suspension. At a `Stiffness` of 0 it is a rigid rod of `Length`, which is what a rope bridge's links are.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Damping` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The damping ratio: 0 bounces for ever, 1 settles without overshooting. |
| `Length` | `number` | `2` | read/write | The rest length, in metres. |
| `MaxLength` | `number` | `1000` | read/write | The longest it may be stretched to, in metres: the end of a bungee. |
| `MinLength` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The shortest it may be squeezed to, in metres, however hard it is pushed. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `4` | read/write | How quickly it springs back, in hertz. 0 makes it rigid. |
